message.content: The incident has been escalated to the DPO for a human decision because the severity score of 3.0 falls within 0.25 of a band threshold [F02][F05][F03]. The decision is to notify the supervisory authority and affected individuals [F03][F04]. Data was disclosed outside the controller via directory_listing to 203.0.113.50 [F03], affecting 2,600 records [F04], with no encryption at rest [F05]. Internal documentation of the breach is required under GDPR Art. 33(5), with phased notification permitted if information is incomplete under Art. 33(4).
